ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: an evening at the fire
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: When the day's done they sit round the fire together, in the same seats, and talk it over.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: a shared table
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They eat together when they can, at the same end of the same table.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: a game night
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They play whatever the rec room holds, and argue about the rules.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: working side by side
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They do the same work, and like to do it within earshot of each other.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: a hunt together
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They go out after game in twos and threes, and come back with stories.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: the small hours
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They keep each other company through the night, when the rest of the colony is asleep.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: prayers together
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They pray, or sit in silence, side by side.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: talking late
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They sit up of an evening and talk, mostly about nothing much.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: a walk at dusk
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: Toward dusk they go out under the open sky together and take the same slow way round.
